narrative_purpose: The chapter's cold-open anchor: an excavation cut into rainforest soil that has produced absolutely nothing, standing beneath a forest visibly crowded with life. The reader must feel the contradiction between what is overhead and what is in the ground before any explanation arrives.
subject: A neat rectangular excavation pit, roughly two metres by one and waist-deep, cut into deep orange-red clay soil. Its four vertical walls are uniform and structureless, threaded through with fine pale white rootlets, with a scatter of small pale quartz pebbles and nothing else - no bone, no shell, no fragment of any kind. Beside the pit sit a stacked pair of empty shallow specimen trays and a coarse sieve with only red clay in it, and a small spoil heap of the same red soil turning to slurry.
scene: The floor of an immense bioluminescent forest, the trunks of colossal trees rising out of frame on all sides, the distant canopy far overhead alive with faint glowing growth; warm rain visibly falling in fine sheets through the shafts between trunks.
camera: A slightly elevated three-quarter view looking down into the pit so all four bare walls and the empty floor are visible at once, with the forest depth receding behind.
light: Cool cyan and living-teal bioluminescent glow filtering down from the canopy and pooling on the wet red clay; the pit interior in deeper indigo shadow; no sunlight, no artificial lamp.
palette: Rust-red and orange clay as the mid-tone against void-indigo shadow, cool cyan and teal glow from above, no warm accent at all - the emptiness should feel cold.
style: Painterly naturalist field plate, hand-painted texture, the composure of a documentary field photograph rather than a dramatic scene.
detail_level: High detail on the clay wall texture, the rootlets, and the empty sieve mesh; the forest behind progressively softer and dissolving into haze.
composition: The pit occupying the lower two-thirds slightly off-centre, generous dark hazy forest above it for later callouts, the empty trays and sieve grouped at one side in clear dark space.
consistency_notes: The pit must read as genuinely empty - not a single skeletal element anywhere in frame, since the whole point of the image is the absence. Cool Pandora palette with no warm accent. Rain and haze part of the identity.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no bones or fossils of any kind, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
